contractDeliverable.note: Present, together with the machine-readable portfolio, the evidence records and the module outputs.

contentObservations.corpusAndItsShape: 773 evidence records were retrieved and profiled. Reviews account for 292 of them and animal studies for 162, against 138 clinical studies, 22 cohorts, 16 systematic reviews, 14 randomised trials, 3 meta-analyses and 4 clinical trials. Clinical work is 26% of the corpus, so most of what supports this direction comes from non-clinical and secondary literature.
contentObservations.recencyConcentration: Year counts are 2026: 576, 2025: 173, 2024: 11, 2023: 8, 2022: 3 and 2027: 2. The 2027 entries sit in the future relative to the corpus's own retrieval date and are best read as metadata artifacts. Either way the corpus is overwhelmingly recent, and no long-run trend can be established from it.
contentObservations.journalConcentration: One immunology journal contributes 37 records and the next largest contributes 26. Microbiology, food-science and materials-interface titles dominate the top of the list, which is what a set mixing microbiome mechanism work with delivery and formulation work would look like.
contentObservations.statusChecking: Publication status is recorded as active for 755 records, corrected for 2 and unknown for 16. A status source is recorded for 757 records and absent for the 16 unknown ones. Those 16 are unchecked instead of confirmed current, and none of the corpus is recorded as retracted.
contentObservations.opportunitiesAndTheirSupport: Three candidate directions were produced, each tied to a named opportunity and to a specific list of source records: a cross-species functional-subtype mapping built on microbial co-metabolism, a Mendelian-randomisation gate for translating animal targets to populations, and a pharmacomicrobiomic decoupling of microbiome-host pathways. Support is recorded as indirect for two of the three and speculative for one, on the rationale that the cited records back adjacent methods or components and not the full proposal.
contentObservations.everyCandidateKeepsItsUncertainty: Each candidate carries an explicit falsification statement, an explicit data requirement, a feasibility caveat and a gaps list. All three gaps lists hold the single entry 'estimand', so the engine derived no formal estimand for any of the three and says so instead of inventing one.
contentObservations.estimatedBoundary: The report keeps the retrieved corpus, the contradiction analysis and the opportunity ranking separate in its own framing. None of the three candidates is asserted to be validated; the strongest support level used anywhere is 'indirect'.

limitationsVisibleInOutput: No live status query was possible in this session. Terminal state and integrity come from the preserved job record and from recomputing the file hashes locally.

An earlier attempt at the same research direction in this workspace failed outright, and a second one failed on a denominator-completeness framing. The delivered record interprets only the supplied successful job. Neither failure is treated here as a finding about the direction itself.
The corpus is extremely recent (576 of 773 records dated 2026), so no maturity or trend claim can be supported from it.
Only 26% of the corpus is clinical, and the directions rest on animal and review literature.
Publication status could not be checked for 16 records, which therefore remain unknown rather than confirmed.
No candidate has a derived estimand; the engine records this as a gap in every case.
Support levels are indirect or speculative throughout, which makes each candidate a hypothesis awaiting test and not a supported conclusion.
Two year entries post-date the corpus's own retrieval and are treated as metadata artifacts.
